summary: Iteration 5 testing complete. Backend instrumentals + download flows verified (13/14 pass). Frontend Boombox feature fully functional: renders correctly, all transport buttons work, play starts audio + spins Deck A reels, next/prev navigate tracks, track-row selection updates active state, free-download flow triggers API + shows Deck B REC for ~4s + toast notifications + anchor download. New logo (c32fw61l) correctly used in hero with rounded-[40px] container. Zero console errors during all interactions. One bug found: artist seed still references old logo URL (ixiugo5j) instead of c32fw61l.

action_items: Update SEED_ARTISTS[0]['image'] (or the DEZ_LOGO constant if intended for site-wide swap) in /app/backend/server.py to use the new logo URL: https://customer-assets.emergentagent.com/job_music-commerce-hub/artifacts/c32fw61l_Gemini_Generated_Image_-EDIT.jpg. Confirm whether DEZ_LOGO should be replaced globally (it is also referenced in dez-tapes-vinyl product image and Home.jsx editorial band — Home.jsx hero already uses the new URL directly, but the editorial band still uses DEZ_LOGO constant). Recommend updating the constant in one place so the swap is consistent everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx hardcodes DEZ_LOGO URL inline (lines 10-13) while backend exposes DEZ_LOGO as a constant — values have diverged. Better: pull all media from API or share via a central config/env. Right now hero shows new logo, but `Editorial Band` and `From the Studio` sections still use the old constants in server.py-fed product/artist images.

Boombox.jsx (431 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold and mixes presentational subcomponents (Reel, EQBars, TransportBtn, Speaker, Deck, TrackRow) with the main controller. Acceptable now but consider extracting subcomponents into separate files for maintainability.

Boombox.jsx useEffect on [idx, current] depends on `isPlaying` (line 86) but does not include it in deps array — could cause stale-closure behaviour. Currently harmless because setIdx triggers re-render with fresh state, but ESLint would flag it.

Boombox.jsx handleDownload uses setTimeout 4000ms to fake recording duration — fine as visual flourish but documented as such. The actual file download via anchor.click() works correctly cross-origin (SoundHelix MP3s).

rca_of_the_issue: Artist logo bug RCA: /app/backend/server.py defines DEZ_LOGO = '...ixiugo5j_Gemini_Generated_Image_.png' (line 24). SEED_ARTISTS[0]['image'] = DEZ_LOGO (line 127). User requested the artist record use the NEW c32fw61l logo, but the DEZ_LOGO constant was never updated in server.py during iteration 5 — only Home.jsx and SEED_INSTRUMENTALS covers were updated. Fix: either change DEZ_LOGO constant to the new URL (cleanest — also propagates to dez-tapes-vinyl product cover and Home editorial band) OR set SEED_ARTISTS[0]['image'] explicitly to the c32fw61l URL. Reproduction: curl $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/artists/dez | grep image.
